plan.title: validate-xml script seems to validate all XML files, not just the one(s) in question
plan.overview: Add optional task ID argument parsing to validate-xml.ts to enable targeted validation of a single task folder's XML files. When a task ID is provided, only validate files in .kanban/tasks/{taskId}/. When no argument is provided, maintain current behavior of validating all task XML files. Also update skill-complete.md partial to pass {taskId}.

approach.rationale:
Following the existing CLI script pattern at find-task.ts:22-30 for argument parsing using process.argv.slice(2). The validateFile() function is already reusable for single file validation. The main change is making getAllXmlFiles() conditional: either collect from a specific task folder or all task folders as before.
Pattern references: - Argument parsing: apps/kanban/src/scripts/find-task.ts:22 - Task folder resolution: apps/kanban/src/scripts/find-task.ts:24-30 - JSON error output: apps/kanban/src/scripts/find-task.ts:25-27
approach.breaking-changes: None - maintains backwards compatibility when no args provided
